_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Crew Resource Management/Threat and Error Management (CRM/TEM) Skills Training Evaluation
summary: The CRM/TEM Skills Training Evaluation documents the status of the contractor's effort toward contract objectives and identifies the trainee's ability to apply proper CRM/TEM procedures.
use_relationship:
The Evaluation includes separate multi-media presentations and case studies for the Initial, Refresher, and Recurring Evaluation Crew Resource Management/Threat and Error Management (CRM/TEM) courses based on topics the Government provides. The CRM/TEM Skills Training Evaluation documents the status of the contractor's effort towards achieving contract objectives. It identifies the ability to apply proper CRM/TEM procedures as prescribed in Air Force Instruction (AFI) 11-290, Cockpit/Crew Resource Management Program. (Copies of AFI 11-290 is available online at: https://static.e-publishing.af.mil/production/1/af_a3/publication/afi11-290/afi11-290.pdf.)

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The CRM/TEM Skills Training Evaluation shall be in accordance with the Air Mobility Command (AMC) Form 4031 and shall be in Adobe Portable Document Format (PDF). (Copies of AMC Form 4031 are available online at: https://static.e-publishing.af.mil/production/1/amc/form/amc4031/amc4031.pdf.)

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The CRM/TEM Skills Training Evaluation shall comply with AMC Form 4031 and shall contain the following:

children.title: Instructor evaluation and comments.
children.content: This data shall contain additional information concerning the trainee's performance and attitude throughout the course. The trainee's completion of homework assignments and seeking extra help or materials to assist in obtaining the learning objectives shall also be described. The instructor's evaluation and comments shall include:

children.title: A description of the trainee's willingness to learn, to participate in class and practical application sessions, and to apply extra effort to the learning situation.
A description of the trainee's application of facts, principles, techniques, theories, concepts, procedures, and experiences previously learned to the new learning situation.
A description of the trainee's accomplishment of the learning objectives during the practical application portion of the course.
The trainee's name in the upper left-hand corner.
